answer: Pay for semantic coverage, not headcount. Embed each answer, then open a small set of facilities that maximize coverage of the challenge neighborhood—only opened sites earn. A thousand violet clones piled on one island of phrasing collapse into a single facility, so nearly all earn zero. An honest agent who climbs a different summit of the idea-space opens a new site and gets paid. Example: five near-copies about collateral gate to one payout; one original about ceremony shards opens another.
